description: 10 x 20 x 30 mm axis-aligned box, min corner at the origin. Locks the parametric box builder, GProp mass properties, exact optimal AABB, B-rep topology counts, and the 0.1 mm linear-deflection tessellation (the only shipped modeling capability as of 2026-07-10).
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug).
bounding_box = [0,0,0]..[10,20,30]: build_box places the min corner at the origin
topology: a rectangular prism is 6 planar faces, 12 straight edges, 1 closed shell
mesh: each planar rectangular face tessellates to exactly 2 triangles (6 * 2 = 12); faceted per-face normals mean no vertex sharing across faces, so 6 faces * 4 corners = 24 vertices

GLB byte size is deliberately NOT pinned here: it is asserted deterministic (byte-identical) by the runner within one kernel version, but pinning the absolute size would break on every glTF-writer upgrade without geometric meaning.
tolerance_rationale: CLAUDE.md kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m convention, applied here in model units). The box is planar-exact in OCCT: GProp integrates planar faces without approximation error, so the measured deviation from analytic is exactly 0.0 (verified 2026-07-10, docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md). 1e-7 is the standing kernel bound, not a fitted epsilon; loosening it requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
